tasks.short: Explain financial risk positions and recommendations in reports and management presentations.

steps.what: Collect exposure balances, market data and limits from the {ERP}, {BANK} and {DOCS}.
Reconcile balances, currencies and reporting dates in the {SPREADSHEET}.
Assess material changes, concentrations and breaches against risk limits.
Assemble charts, explanations and recommendations in a report stored in the {DOCS}.

loop.input: Validated figures, specialist risk findings and an approved report template.
loop.output: Draft explanations linked to source figures and findings.
loop.check: Generate charts deterministically; verify numerical references and source links; specialist checks interpretation.
loop.stop: One draft and one repair pass per section; unsupported claims remain blank for manual completion.
loop.why_not_simpler: Templates handle tables and charts, but changing findings need short contextual explanations.

steps.what: Review conclusions and approve the report for its intended audience.
Present findings, answer challenges and capture requested follow-up.

tasks.design: A scheduled integration on the {DATA_PLATFORM} reconciles {ERP} and {BANK} balances, applies approved limits and feeds the {BI}. A report generator combines fixed charts with a bounded narrative draft in the {DOCS}; the finance manager approves release, and follow-up enters the {PROJECT}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Source mappings, reporting dates and report layouts differed. Building and maintaining a reliable reporting pipeline cost more than repeated manual assembly.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing exports, APIs and templates support deterministic reporting. AI-assisted coding can reduce implementation effort, while a bounded drafting loop handles changing explanations.
tasks.still_hard: Economic interpretation, incomplete positions and disagreement over materiality remain difficult. A reconciled number can still support a misleading conclusion.
tasks.human_edge: Explain what an exposure means for the business, challenge comforting narratives and answer management questions.

ambition.what: Weekly concentration-risk review between formal reporting cycles.

tasks.altitude: The week shifts from assembling packs to investigating changes and preparing management choices. Approval rights stay with the finance manager; the specialist gains no automatic authority to change limits.

reach.task: Maintain a shared exposure dataset and its reporting definitions.
reach.learn: Data lineage, reconciliation controls and effective dashboard design.

reach.task: Translate exposure changes into cash and hedging discussion points.
reach.learn: Liquidity constraints, hedge instruments and treasury decision calendars.

evidence.claim: Financial risk reporting commonly combines structured exposure data with specialist interpretation; the proposed time shares are estimates.
Moody's Credit Memo drafts financial narratives from spreads, documents and a template; this supports the drafting pattern, not complete risk-report automation.
Baker Tilly Netherlands reported faster statement checking with DataSnipper; this is adjacent reconciliation evidence, not a savings estimate for this task.

assumptions: The typical setting is a corporate finance or treasury team, with periodic management reporting.
A reusable report template and approved risk limits exist.
Time shares are planning estimates informed by the supplied priors; review and presentation remain substantial.
Build ranges are working-day estimates for a narrow pilot. Access includes confidentiality controls, GDPR review where personal data is present, and any consultation required by national rules.
unknowns: Which exposures, entities and reporting frequencies are in scope?
Can the {ERP} and {BANK} provide complete dated exports or APIs?
Who owns balance reconciliation and report approval?
Does the report contain personal data or employee-level information?
Which national consultation requirements apply?
research_questions: Which reconciliation controls reliably detect missing positions and inconsistent valuation dates?
What source-linking and retention controls can the available {DOCS} and {DATA_PLATFORM} support?
new_work: Resolve failed imports and unmatched balances.
Review narrative claims and numerical references.
Maintain source mappings, report templates and limits.
Check that report access and retention remain appropriate.

tasks.short: Advise departments on statistical methods, assumptions and model limitations.

steps.what: Clarify the department's decision, outcome measure and practical constraints.
Supply sample data, field definitions and the existing model through the {DOCS}.
Run diagnostics in the {OTHER} statistical analysis environment.
Compare methods and judge assumptions, validation needs and model suitability.
Discuss trade-offs and agree which method the department will test.
Document the agreed method, limitations and follow-up in the {DOCS}.

tasks.design: A configured intake in the {WORKFLOW} collects the decision brief and approved data package, then runs a versioned diagnostic suite on the {DATA_PLATFORM}. Fixed templates produce the advice note in the {DOCS}; the specialist selects methods and discusses their limits with the department.
tasks.previous_blocker: Requests arrived with different datasets and unclear objectives. Reusable diagnostic scripts existed separately from intake, documentation and follow-up.
tasks.enabler_now: A small records workflow and reusable statistical code can connect those pieces. AI-assisted coding helps build adapters and templates; production model reasoning is unnecessary for the standard path.
tasks.still_hard: Choosing a valid target, spotting leakage, distinguishing correlation from causation and judging whether data represents future conditions remain expert work.
tasks.human_edge: Discover the decision behind the request and explain uncertainty in terms the department can use.

ambition.what: A recurring modelling clinic for department analysts without dedicated statistical support.

tasks.altitude: The specialist spends less time repeating diagnostics and more time teaching sound analytical choices. Departments retain authority over their decisions, and model deployment still follows existing approval rights.

reach.task: Define out-of-time validation and model monitoring plans.
reach.learn: Data leakage, uncertainty estimation and model drift.

reach.task: Test forecast assumptions and explain forecast error.
reach.learn: Forecast evaluation, business drivers and asymmetric decision costs.

evidence.claim: Standard profiling, missingness checks, validation splits and diagnostic reports can run as deterministic statistical code.
Method selection and interpretation depend on the decision, data-generating process and consequences; the supplied priors support retaining substantial human work.
The digest's spreadsheet benchmark found material arithmetic failures, supporting deterministic numerical checks rather than model-generated calculations.

assumptions: The service advises internal departments and does not automatically deploy models.
An initial diagnostic library covers a small set of recurring statistical questions.
Advice notes use structured conclusions and templates, so a language-model loop is not required.
Build ranges cover one department pilot, access review and applicable consultation under national rules. GDPR and EU AI Act applicability depend on data and intended use.
unknowns: Which modelling requests recur often enough to standardise?
Are existing models reproducible and their datasets accessible?
Who may approve test plans and production model use?
Do requests concern employees, natural-person creditworthiness or other regulated decisions?
What validation standards and national consultation requirements already apply?
research_questions: Which diagnostics are appropriate for each supported model family?
Which intended uses trigger additional GDPR or EU AI Act requirements?
How should generated diagnostic reports expose uncertainty and invalid assumptions?
new_work: Maintain diagnostic suites and supported method templates.
Investigate failed tests and unsuitable datasets.
Review generated advice notes before sharing.
Track whether departments act within the advice's stated limitations.

tasks.short: Recommend investments and timing within the company's liquidity needs and risk mandate.

steps.what: Confirm liquidity needs, investment horizon and authorised instruments with the treasurer.
Gather holdings, available quotes and issuer data from the {BANK} and {OTHER} market-data service.
Compare returns, maturities, concentration and stress losses in the {SPREADSHEET}.
Judge investment suitability and timing against liquidity uncertainty and downside risk.
Write the recommendation, alternatives and timing rationale in the {DOCS}.
Discuss the proposal and approve, defer or reject the investment recommendation.
Record the decision and agreed conditions in the {DOCS}.

tasks.design: The {DATA_PLATFORM} joins dated {BANK} holdings, licensed market data from the {OTHER} and the approved mandate, then calculates comparisons and stress scenarios for the {BI}. A fixed proposal template in the {DOCS} records the specialist's recommendation, and the {WORKFLOW} captures the treasurer's decision without placing orders.
tasks.previous_blocker: Quote feeds, cash forecasts and investment mandates were disconnected. Bespoke calculations and approvals were expensive to connect and maintain.
tasks.enabler_now: Deterministic valuation libraries, scheduled feeds and configurable approvals are established technology. AI-assisted coding can make a narrow comparison and proposal workflow cheaper to build.
tasks.still_hard: Market outcomes cannot be validated in advance. Liquidity uncertainty, issuer deterioration and timing decisions remain judgement calls.
tasks.human_edge: Balance downside protection, uncertain cash needs and business priorities, then defend a recommendation when outcomes are uncertain.

ambition.what: Daily review of surplus-cash maturity choices when forecasts or market rates change.

tasks.altitude: The specialist spends more time challenging liquidity assumptions and comparing choices with the treasurer. Investment approval and execution rights remain within the existing mandate.

reach.task: Choose an investment maturity ladder consistent with the cash forecast.
reach.learn: Liquidity buffers, settlement constraints and counterparty limits.

reach.task: Assess issuer fundamentals and downside investment scenarios.
reach.learn: Issuer analysis, duration and instrument-specific valuation.

evidence.claim: For a mid-size non-financial company, this task commonly concerns internal surplus-cash investments rather than public investment recommendations.
Mandate screening, maturity comparisons and specified stress calculations can use deterministic code; investment timing remains uncertain.
The digest's spreadsheet benchmark supports independently checking financial arithmetic; it does not establish investment recommendation quality.

assumptions: The pilot covers internal treasury recommendations for a limited set of authorised instruments.
External client or public investment advice requires a separate scope and regulatory assessment.
A structured recommendation form captures rationale, alternatives and conditions, avoiding a production language-model loop.
Build ranges include market-data access, a representative instrument test set and rollout. Applicable GDPR, EU AI Act and national requirements are checked against actual use.
unknowns: Is the employer a corporate treasury function or a regulated investment business?
Which instruments, currencies and valuation methods are required?
Are market data licensed for automated use and derived reporting?
How reliable and timely is the cash forecast?
Who can approve investments, and where is that approval recorded?
Does the workflow involve personal data or employee monitoring requiring consultation under national rules?
research_questions: Which valuation methods and market-data freshness checks fit the supported instruments?
Which investment-advice requirements apply if the audience extends beyond internal treasury?
What benchmark datasets can validate stress calculations and cash-flow treatment?
new_work: Resolve stale quotes, missing instruments and feed failures.
Maintain instrument definitions, mandate rules and scenario assumptions.
Validate calculations when new instrument types are introduced.
Review whether forecasts and recommendation conditions remain current.

tasks.short: Recommend practical controls that reduce financial risk within business constraints.

steps.what: Review exposure changes, losses and limit breaches in the {BI}.
Discuss causes, existing controls and operational constraints with the process owner.
Compare control costs, exposure reduction and stress outcomes in the {SPREADSHEET}.
Select a control recommendation and document residual risk in the {DOCS}.
Agree the proposed control, implementation owner and acceptable residual risk.
Approve the control change, funding and residual-risk acceptance within delegated authority.
Record approved actions, owners and review dates in the {PROJECT}.

tasks.design: Configured views in the {BI} expose breaches, while deterministic calculations on the {DATA_PLATFORM} compare approved control options and stress assumptions. Structured recommendations in the {DOCS} pass through a decision flow in the {WORKFLOW}, which creates approved actions and review dates in the {PROJECT}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Exposure reports, control registers, calculations and approval mail were disconnected. Control choices also depended on operational knowledge absent from the records.
tasks.enabler_now: A small workflow can connect existing records and reusable scenario calculations. AI-assisted coding lowers the cost of these connections; a model loop is unnecessary for the initial structured control library.
tasks.still_hard: Control effectiveness is often uncertain, and losses may be too rare to estimate it reliably. A control can move risk elsewhere or impose costs its sponsor overlooks.
tasks.human_edge: Find feasible controls with process owners and judge whether residual risk is acceptable.

ambition.what: A scheduled control-effectiveness review comparing approved expectations with observed outcomes.

tasks.altitude: The specialist spends more time testing whether controls work and discussing trade-offs with process owners. Funding, policy changes and residual-risk acceptance remain with authorised managers.

reach.task: Test whether a financial control operates as designed.
reach.learn: Control evidence, sampling limits and design versus operating effectiveness.

reach.task: Assess legal constraints on proposed risk controls.
reach.learn: Proportionality, data protection and the boundary between financial and compliance risk.

evidence.claim: Exposure monitoring, scenario comparisons and action tracking can use configured workflows and deterministic calculations; choosing controls remains contextual.
Hawk documents monitoring with alert reasons and human review; this supports separating detection from consequential decisions.
The digest identifies Dutch works-council consent requirements for systems monitoring employee behaviour. Other jurisdictions require assessment under national rules.

assumptions: The initial scope covers financial exposure controls, not automated decisions about individual employees or borrowers.
The finance manager can approve the scoped changes; matters beyond delegated authority escalate through existing governance.
Build ranges cover a limited control library, access review and applicable consultation. Formal consultation under national rules can extend elapsed time.
GDPR applies where controls process personal data; EU AI Act obligations depend on whether AI is used and its intended purpose.
unknowns: Is there a current control register with named owners and approval thresholds?
Can exposure and loss data support credible comparisons?
Which control changes require approval beyond the finance manager?
Would any proposed control monitor employees or affect natural-person credit decisions?
Which national consultation requirements and internal risk-acceptance rules apply?
research_questions: How can effectiveness be measured when adverse events are rare?
Which proposed controls require a data protection impact assessment or additional AI governance?
Which outcome measures detect risk transferred to another process?
new_work: Maintain control options, assumptions and escalation thresholds.
Review misleading alerts and unsupported effectiveness estimates.
Follow up overdue actions and validate closure evidence.
Compare observed outcomes with the original control rationale.

role.altitude: The role shifts toward interpreting exposures, challenging assumptions and evaluating decisions after implementation. Better preparation expands analytical capacity; investment authority, risk acceptance and policy approval still require explicit delegation.
reach: Treasurer: connect exposure analysis to liquidity and investment maturity decisions.
Business Intelligence Analyst: maintain shared exposure definitions and reconciled datasets.
Data Scientist: strengthen validation, uncertainty estimates and model monitoring.
Accountant and Auditor: test control operation and evidence quality.
Compliance Officer: assess legal constraints on data use and consequential controls.
skills_to_grow: Data contracts, reconciliation and source lineage.
Reproducible financial calculations and scenario testing.
Clear recommendations and difficult management conversations.
GDPR, EU AI Act applicability and relevant national rules.
role.ambitious_version: Provide an integrated financial-risk review service that joins exposure changes, cash constraints, scenario choices and control outcomes. Bring management timely choices with traceable evidence, then test whether accepted decisions delivered the expected protection.
